name: Do you handle both residential and commercial cabinet projects?

mainEntity.name: Do you handle both residential and commercial cabinet projects?

acceptedAnswer.text: Frasheski Construction primarily focuses on residential cabinet services, helping homeowners create functional and beautiful spaces. While our expertise is tailored to residential needs, we may consider small-scale commercial projects on a case-by-case basis. Please contact us to discuss your specific commercial project requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: We primarily focus on residential cabinet projects, but may consider small commercial projects on a case-by-case basis.
